items.headline: Bitquery estimates US$93.2m in CryptoBilis-linked wallet thefts
items.what_happened: Bitquery’s chain analysis estimates that 315 wallets lost about US$93.2m in the 9 October incident across six chains. Its balance snapshot ends at 07:00 UTC on 10 October.
items.why_it_matters: The investigation concerns reported losses among CryptoBilis reseller customers. It highlights recovery-key and hardware-supply-chain risks without establishing the cause.
items.risk: These are the researcher’s estimates, not a confirmed loss total. How keys were exposed remains unresolved; the report does not establish that all Ledger devices or services were compromised.
